title: Design System: Random Acts of Santa

display.purpose: The stacked three-line wordmark only, with the year postmark.

headline.purpose: Section heads (expanded caps on navy) and the hero hook (bold, sentence case).

title.purpose: Station titles, modal titles, card names.

body.purpose: Reading text at normal width; frost-soft on navy, ink-soft on label.

label.purpose: Field captions, card headers, state tags, form labels. Never a kicker above a heading.

figures.purpose: Every count, date and number; public totals rounded and shown as N+.

shadows.name: button-post
shadows.purpose: Red glow under the primary button only.

motion.name: frank
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: a postmark lands on a label (hero load, a wishlist marked Gifted).

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button background, colour and press transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion everything rests immediately; the postmark simply appears.

surfaces.name: airmail
surfaces.purpose: 10px band on the top edge of label surfaces; solid pine on a gifted card.

surfaces.name: perforated
surfaces.value: padding: 6px; background: radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 2px, #fffdf8 2.5px) -4px -4px / 8px 8px
surfaces.purpose: Punched stamp edge around the bauble stamp.

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Quiet Button (on night)

components.name: Postmark
components.description: Double-ring date stamp with ring text and a large centre line; gold on navy, gold-ink on label, pine for SENT. Lands with the frank.
components.css: .ds-pm-wrap{background:var(--color-night,#13264d);padding:24px;display:inline-block}.ds-pm{font-family: var(--font-archivo, Archivo), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;width:120px;color:var(--color-gold,#caa24c);transform:rotate(-10deg);animation:ds-frank 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both}@keyframes ds-frank{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.35) rotate(-14deg);filter:blur(2px)}60%{opacity:1;transform:scale(.96) rotate(-9deg);filter:blur(0)}100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) rotate(-10deg)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-pm{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Every gift on Random Acts of Santa is a parcel sent to someone whose address you never learn, so the whole interface is built from the Christmas post: a night-navy winter sky as the ground, the incumbent hanging baubles above it, and working surfaces cut from cream label stock with hairline ink rules, an airmail band on the edge, perforated stamps and gold date-stamp postmarks. It is festive without being religious or childish: the season comes from the post office and the night sky, not from snowmen and emoji.

Density is calm. A screen holds one held moment (on the home page, the parcel label itself is the hero) and everything else sits on a strict ruled grid: label rows, numbered stations on a line, cards in even columns. Live data is part of the material, not a widget: counts are franked onto labels and set in tabular figures. Type is one family, Archivo, used across its width axis: expanded caps for the franked wordmark, headings and label captions, regular width for reading.

There is one authored motion, the frank: a postmark pressing onto a label once, on load or when a wishlist is marked Gifted. Everything else is still.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds only: night sky (dark) and label stock (cream). No third surface family.
Postal red is the one action colour; gold is the postmark ink; pine means sent.
Archivo across widths: expanded for marks and captions, normal for reading.
Hairline rules and the airmail band do the structuring; no decorative chrome.
Counts in tabular figures; public totals rounded and shown as "N+".
One motion: the frank. Reduced motion shows the postmark at rest.

rules.name: The One Stamp Of Red Rule
rules.body: Postal red marks what you can do: buttons, links, destructive actions. It never decorates a heading or a panel. The only red that is not an action is the wordmark's "ACTS OF" line in lamp red, and it stays the only one; other emphasis on navy uses pale gold.

rules.name: The Gold Is Ink Rule
rules.body: Gold is postmark ink and the year mark. It is never a button, a fill or a background. On label stock, postmarks switch to postmark ink (gold-ink).

rules.name: The Pine Means Sent Rule
rules.body: Pine appears only for the gifted/sent state, and always with words ("Gift sent", "SENT"), never as colour alone.

rules.name: The Field Caption Rule
rules.body: Expanded caps are captions for a field or a mark (a label row, a tag, a postmark), never a kicker stacked above a heading.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Numbers are always set in tabular lining figures. Public totals are rounded before display: under 10 hidden, floored to the nearest 10, to the nearest 50 above 1,000, and shown as "N+".

rules.name: The Ruled Grid Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from hairline rules and fixed columns, not from nested cards. If a group needs separating, rule it.

rules.name: The Paper Not Glass Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are opaque paper. No translucency, blur or glass panels; the one exception is the dark scrim behind a modal.

dos: **Do** keep the page on two grounds: night sky for the page, label stock for anything you read closely or act on.
**Do** use postal red only for actions (buttons, links, destructive text); use pale gold for emphasis inside navy headings.
**Do** switch postmarks to gold-ink on label stock and pine for the sent state.
**Do** set every number in tabular figures, and round public totals (hide under 10, floor to 10, to 50 above 1,000, show as "N+").
**Do** separate content with hairline rules and the airmail band rather than extra boxes.
**Do** keep touch targets at 44px and check every change at 1280x800 and Pixel 7 widths.
**Do** keep the frank as the only authored motion and honour reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use emoji as icons; draw icons as SVG.
**Don't** put an eyebrow kicker above a heading; expanded caps are for field captions, tags and marks only.
**Don't** use gradient text, glass or blurred translucent panels.
**Don't** mark a card with a coloured side stripe; state goes in the top band, a tag and words.
**Don't** add a second red emphasis on navy beyond the wordmark's "ACTS OF" line.
**Don't** use gold for buttons, fills or backgrounds.
**Don't** show exact small counts, names or per-organisation numbers in public stats.
